The '''fatalists of Plootark IX''' were a mysterious group found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Plootark IX]]. The fatalists are credited with the invention of absolute [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor technology]] that caused [[Class-D annihilation|Class-D disintegration]], also known as transcendental annihilation. The technologies that resulted from their invention, such as [[Class-D detonator]]s, were outlawed across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] because they were considered an affront to life.
